limitations: Caption-layer visual status not_inspected in this annotation; the two PSG figure images were inspected in visual.json.

The five case paragraphs (b00055 to b00059) sit under the section headings Patient 1 to Patient 5 (segment headings CASE PRESENTATION / Patient N), which is the literal patient attribution; the figure captions, Table rows and discussion patient numbers agree with it.
Table 1 patient 1 baseline sleep efficiency 64 conflicts with the case text 67; Table 2 patient 5 PSQI 14 and 5 conflict with the case text 12 and 4. Both sides are review_only source conflicts.
Table 2 prints the PSQI as a 0-15 scale and ESS healthy values close to 6 in its footnote; these printed scale notes are not used for flags or conversions.

Table 1 footnote says no sleep-associated breathing symptoms occurred (not shown) without naming patients; it conflicts in wording with patient 1 light obstructive sleep apnea on PSG and was not recorded as a fact.
Iron, ferritin and transferrin values are not reported; only the statement that iron deficiency was ruled out in all patients.
Bryophyllum pinnatum tablet composition (350 mg tablet, leaf press juice, lactose) in b00005 is a general product description and not recorded as a patient fact.

Discussion statements about four of five patients (PLMS lowering, IRLS reduction, benefit) are cohort statements and were not copied to individual patients; only literally labelled statements were used.
